lessons.title: 22. Tool Result Message (Practice)
lessons.description: After executing a tool, the model must see the result message tied to the originating call — the OpenAI guide references tool calls by a `call_id`. Implement tool_result_message(call_id, content) returning {'role': 'tool', 'call_id': call_id, 'content': content}. Tests check role, call_id and content.
lessons.solution_code:
def tool_result_message(call_id, content):
    return {'role': 'tool', 'call_id': call_id, 'content': content}

tests.name: test_tool_result_message
tests.unittest_code:
def test_tool_result_message(self):
    m = tool_result_message('c1', 'ok')
    self.assertEqual(m['role'], 'tool')
    self.assertEqual(m['call_id'], 'c1')
    self.assertEqual(m['content'], 'ok')
